{{Quote|Migs Mayfeld. Serving 50 years in the Karthon Chop Fields for springing a prisoner himself.|Cara Dune reads a profile on Migs Mayfeld|<ref name="Chapter 14" />}}
'''Karthon''' was a [[prison]] [[moon]] located in the [[Zuma sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Situated at the coordinates H-16 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was connected by [[hyperspace route]] to the astronomical objects [[Rattatak]]<ref name="CLNE" /> and [[Necropolis]].<ref name="Galaxy Map">[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], Karthon contributed materials towards the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

After the war, the victorious [[New Republic]], the Alliance's successor, used the scrapyard known as the [[Karthon Chop Fields]] a correctional facility, where former Imperial machinery would be dismantled by inmates.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY">{{MandoDate|15}}</ref> [[Migs Mayfeld]], an inmate who had been sentenced to fifty [[Standard year|years]] at the Karthon Chop Fields for his involvement in the [[Bothan-Five incident|breakout]] of a [[Qin|prisoner]] and the [[death]] of the [[corrections officer]] [[Lant Davan]],<ref name="Chapter 14" /> was relinquished into the care of [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]] to assist them in locating of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's light cruiser|light cruiser]].<ref name="Chapter 15" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karthon was first mentioned in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> and aired on [[December 4]] [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> The location then first appeared in the following episode "[[Chapter 15: The Believer]]," which was directed by [[Rick Famuyiwa]]<ref name="Chapter 15" /> and released on [[December 11]] 2020.<ref name="D23" />
